materials.title: Retained Rocky Land and Rivers height-map archive and staged transformations

identity.relationship: The ZIP is the material anchor; tracked and ignored PNG, PDF, DOCX, and preview copies are transformations or license sidecars, not independent authorities.

intendedClaims: Retains the exact historical height-map input, its bundled license sidecar, and transformations needed to reconstruct the terrain display fixture.

contradictions.summary: The selected production design requires local incoming directions in a Sun-subpoint radial/tangential/up frame, while the frozen CPU Reference cache stores and samples fixed-frame directions without runtime position-azimuth rotation.
contradictions.scope: Production local-Sun incident-radiance cache coordinate frame and rotational covariance
contradictions.currentObservation: FACT-A32-000218 records an implemented z/rho/fixed-direction cache that omits position azimuth and runtime direction rotation; the selected design-side fact requires a Sun-subpoint local radial/tangential/up direction frame.
contradictions.desiredState: The CPU Reference and selected design must agree on one exact local direction-frame transform, cache-key domain, and rotational-covariance contract with executable tests.
contradictions.requiredAction: Specify and implement the Sun-subpoint frame transform and covariance mapping, or explicitly revise the selected design after an independent symmetry/error review; then test equivalent rotated queries and cache samples across the target domain.
blockers: No exact Sun-subpoint frame equations, runtime azimuth rotation, cache-key update, migration policy, or accepted covariance experiment is present.

contradictions.summary: The retired research, current globe application, shared Sun packet, and abandoned fixture scenarios author 696,340 kilometers, while current and legacy POC globe-state providers author 695,700 kilometers.
contradictions.scope: Current application, shared, fixture, and historical POC solar-radius input convention
contradictions.currentObservation: Two distinct numeric solar-radius values survive across current and historical consumers without an exact source and radius-definition convention pinned to either side.
contradictions.desiredState: One explicitly named solar-radius convention with an exact primary-source locator must own the selected value, with other values retained only as qualified historical inputs.
contradictions.requiredAction: Verify the intended mean, nominal, photospheric, or other radius definition, select its exact value, and update or qualify each consumer.
blockers: Neither local value is linked to a verified exact primary-source claim and radius definition.
